page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 40 physical cores and 40 vCPUs with a single thread per core configuration, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.8 GB of memory per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. Memory performance tests show a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec, which drops to 108.89 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 48.09 GB/sec. The system demonstrates strong text and data processing capabilities, with a Redis SET throughput of 34.78 million operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, Geekbench software compilation with Clang scores 28733.0, and ray tracing scores 29129.0.

The lack of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, making this instance unsuitable for heavy graphics rendering or local-disk-intensive databases. However, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed provide stable, predictable compute performance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated physical cores relative to memory makes it a balanced option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. This instance is suited for multi-threaded CPU processing, software compilation, web serving, and medium-scale database operations.
